---
name: Device support request
about: Ask for (or offer to test) a device plugin
labels: device-support
---

**Device:** (brand + model)
**USB ID:** (Device Manager → Details → Hardware Ids, e.g. `VID_1B1C&PID_0C1C`)
**What it has:** RGB / fans / temperature sensors
**Reference driver, if you know one:** (OpenRGB / liquidctl / OpenLinkHub / Linux kernel)
**Can you test a plugin on it?** yes / no
